CustomField.inlineHelpText: One line per Document Category: Category | Template Document Number | Number Prefix | headings. Example: Policy | TMP-POL-000 | POL | Policy Purpose; Principles of this Policy; Definitions. The template numbers the document; with no template, the prefix plus the next free number is suggested. The headings pick the best-fit template when AI is off.
